newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni captors hand French diplomat to negotiators.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni captors hand French diplomat to negotiators.

text.p: A French diplomat, kidnapped in Yemen five days ago, was handed over to negotiators by his captors on Saturday who were expected to hand him over to the authorities soon, a Yemeni official said.
"The French diplomat will be handed over to Yemeni authorities and the French Embassy within three hours," the spokesman for the governer of Marib province Abdul Wali al-Shumairi told Reuters.

The spokesman said the captors, members of al-Toaiman tribe, released their hostage to three tribal chiefs from Marib, 170 km (100 miles) northeast of Sanaa, who were mediating on behalf of the government.
The kidnappers had dropped their demands earlier and asked for a guarantee that they would not be prosecuted if they released their hostage.
It was not immediatly clear what arrangements were reached by the negotiators.

The Toaiman tribe demanded government compensation for losses inflicted on homes, farms, water pumps and wells by floods that killed 65 people in June. It also wants more job opportunities and the settlement of a land dispute.
